placeholderConvention: Templates are the ONLY source of framework code; the LLM never writes framework calls. Placeholders: {locator} Playwright selector, {by} Selenium By constant, {locator_value} Selenium locator value, {value}/{expected} step parameters, {variable} runtime variable name, {timeout_ms}/{timeout_s} wait timeout. String values are inserted as Python literals (repr); raw text is never interpolated.

web_navigate.description: Open a URL in the current browser page.

requiredParameters.name: value
requiredParameters.description: Absolute http(s) URL, or a URL that starts with a ${VARIABLE}.

validationRules.message: web_navigate needs an absolute http(s) URL or a URL starting with ${VARIABLE}

requiredParameters.name: object
requiredParameters.description: Object repository name of the element to click.

web_setText.description: Replace the text of an input element.

requiredParameters.name: object
requiredParameters.description: Object repository name of the input element.

requiredParameters.name: value
requiredParameters.description: Text to enter; an empty string clears the field.

selenium.note: clear() first so the result matches Playwright fill(), which replaces existing text.

web_getText.description: Read the visible text of a web element into a runtime variable.
web_getText.assumption: ICAP semantics unconfirmed: 'value' is treated as the name of the runtime variable that receives the text.

requiredParameters.name: object
requiredParameters.description: Object repository name of the element to read.

requiredParameters.name: value
requiredParameters.description: Runtime variable name that receives the text.

validationRules.message: web_getText needs a valid variable name in 'value'

playwright.note: inner_text() returns rendered text, matching Selenium's WebElement.text.

web_assertText.description: Assert that a web element's text equals the expected text.

requiredParameters.name: object
requiredParameters.description: Object repository name of the element to check.

requiredParameters.name: expected
requiredParameters.description: Expected full text of the element.

playwright.note: Auto-retries until the timeout and normalises whitespace.

web_wait.description: Wait until a web element is visible.
web_wait.assumption: ICAP semantics unconfirmed: treated as 'wait for element visible'; optional 'value' is a timeout in milliseconds.

requiredParameters.name: object
requiredParameters.description: Object repository name of the element to wait for.

validationRules.message: web_wait timeout must be a whole number of milliseconds between 1 and 300000

imports: from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC

web_select.description: Select a dropdown option by its value attribute.

requiredParameters.name: object
requiredParameters.description: Object repository name of the <select> element.

requiredParameters.name: value
requiredParameters.description: Value attribute of the option to select.

validationRules.message: web_select needs a non-empty option value
